name: Fable rebuilds
author: Brett
description: Every build parked for Fable in one place: what each replaces (the Opus plugin and its uninstall command), its branch, differences report, Android before/after screenshots and rebuild-log line, plus a ready-to-paste brief for the Fable session. Hooks: nav, the default context menu, Plugin Manager rows, Plan features and Pending builds rows (open it, or park a new Fable rebuild).
